data.headline: Raise price 5% in week 3 and add 2 weeks of safety stock now
data.why: The bridge shows a $3,074 gain from the price increase that outweighs the $1,033 volume loss, while the $1,326 cost hedge covers the 85% bean-cost exposure. Rival Highlands Coffee just hit 1,000 stores, so independent cafés will need a reliable backup supplier.
data.watch_out: If bean costs jump more than the 30% assumed, the 5% price rise won't cover the extra $1.93 per bag and margins shrink fast.
data.recheck_when: Re-check when the next Central Highlands harvest report or global robusta futures update is published.
